senses.definition: A thin material produced by pressing together moist fibers, used for writing, printing, or drawing.

examples.text: Necesito una hoja de papel para escribir una nota.
examples.translation: I need a sheet of paper to write a note.
examples.emotion: focused and practical, looking for the right tool

senses.definition: The character or part played by an actor in a play, movie, or performance.

examples.text: Ella interpretó el papel principal en la obra.
examples.translation: She played the lead role in the play.
examples.emotion: admiring and enthusiastic about a performance

senses.definition: An official document, often used in the plural 'papeles' for identification or permits.

examples.text: Tengo que organizar todos los papeles de la oficina.
examples.translation: I have to organize all the office paperwork.
examples.emotion: slightly overwhelmed by the amount of work to do
